{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Citizen Plush''' is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health, higher than most enemies that appeared before it, with the exception of the [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]], while also being faster than all except the [[Quick]]. ==Appearance== The '''Citizen Plush''' is a humanoid made of plush fabric. It has a tan skin color, a khaki shirt, dark brown pants and a khaki hat. It also has black buttons for its eyes and a stitched khaki mouth. ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Shotgunner]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] can be quite effective against this. **Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Ranger]] should be able to kill it with ease. *As this generally spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be useful against this. **As it is also somewhat fast for its health, the [[Electroshocker]] can also be useful at stalling it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1CitizenPlush.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCitizen.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CitizenPlushIndex.png|'''Citizen Plush''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Its appearance is based on the [[Citizen 1]] and [[Citizen 2]] units that appeared in the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Citizen Plush''' added. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|300}} to {{Money|400}} upon death. {{PizzaParty|[[Breaker2]]|Wave 12|Citizen Plush|Wave 14|[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
